prefs.exclusive.title: Exclusive mode
prefs.exclusive.desc: Make Yozakura the only shell on this Hyprland session, with a full backup and one-click restore.
prefs.exclusive.off.title: Make Yozakura the only shell
prefs.exclusive.off.detail: Other bars, notification and wallpaper daemons stop competing for the screen, and your old Hyprland files stop overriding Yozakura. Nothing is deleted.
prefs.exclusive.on.title: Yozakura is your only shell
prefs.exclusive.on.detail: Hyprland loads a minimal entry file that starts Yozakura. Your previous setup is safe in the backup below.
prefs.exclusive.step.backup.detail: Your whole ~/.config/hypr folder is copied (symlinks included) into %1
prefs.exclusive.step.entry.detail: It loads Yozakura, then %1 for your own tweaks. Old config files stay on disk but are no longer loaded.
prefs.exclusive.step.units.none: No other bar, notification, wallpaper or idle daemons are enabled in systemd.
prefs.exclusive.step.import: Your monitors and keyboard carry over
prefs.exclusive.step.import.none: No monitor or keyboard settings found in your Hyprland files.
prefs.exclusive.safety: Hyprland reloads right away. If the new setup reports a config error, everything is put back automatically. Restore is always available here and with: yozakura install --restore.
prefs.exclusive.confirm.enable.title: Make Yozakura the only shell?
prefs.exclusive.confirm.enable.body: Your Hyprland folder is backed up, the entry file is replaced, the listed services are disabled and Hyprland reloads.
prefs.exclusive.confirm.restore.title: Restore your previous setup?
prefs.exclusive.confirm.restore.body: Your Hyprland folder comes back exactly as saved in %1 and the disabled services are enabled again. The current files are kept next to the backup.
prefs.exclusive.restored.title: Your previous setup is back
prefs.exclusive.restored.detail: The files exclusive mode replaced are saved in %1. Imported monitor and keyboard settings were kept.
prefs.exclusive.active.tweaks.detail: ~/.config/hypr/%1 loads after Yozakura, so it can override anything.
prefs.sys.weather_location.desc: City name or "lat,lon". Leave empty to detect it from your IP.
prefs.sys.weather_unit.desc: Unit used by the weather widgets.
prefs.sys.rotate_cover.desc: Spin the album art like a vinyl disc while music plays.
prefs.sys.dashboard_persist.desc: Keep dashboard tabs loaded after leaving them: faster switching, more memory.
prefs.sys.dashboard_max_tabs.desc: Most dashboard tabs kept in memory at once.
prefs.sys.lock_cmd.desc: Runs when the session locks (loginctl lock-session, idle listeners).
prefs.sys.idle_listeners.desc: Commands run after a period without input, in order: dim, lock, screen off, suspend. On resume runs when you come back.

prefs.sys.idle_on_resume.placeholder: Optional command when you are back

prefs.sys.after_sleep.desc: Runs when the computer wakes up, e.g. to turn the screens back on.
prefs.sys.disks.desc: Mount points shown in the system metrics.
prefs.sys.disks.empty: No disks: storage usage is hidden.
prefs.sys.clipboard_tmpfs.desc: Unpinned history lives in /tmp and is wiped on reboot. Pinned items always stay on disk.

prefs.notif.status.desc: Where notifications appear with your current preset.
prefs.notif.status.notch: Toasts grow out of the notch
prefs.notif.status.dnd: Do Not Disturb is on: only priority and critical ones show.
prefs.notif.status.live: Changes apply to the next notification.

prefs.notif.max_visible.desc: Older toasts slip into the history when more arrive.
prefs.notif.group.desc: One toast and one history card per app instead of one per notification.
prefs.notif.history.desc: Notifications kept in the dashboard after they hide.
prefs.notif.sound.desc: A short chime when a toast appears (never during Do Not Disturb).
prefs.notif.sound_file.desc: Any file pw-play or paplay can play. Empty uses the built-in tone.

prefs.notif.dnd_critical.desc: Critical notifications (low battery, alarms) still show during Do Not Disturb.

prefs.notif.schedule_to.desc: End time; earlier than the start means the next morning.

prefs.effects.intensity.desc: How strong the effect is. Lowered automatically when text would become hard to read.

prefs.effects.grain.desc: Rice-paper texture; full on light surfaces, faint on dark ones.
prefs.effects.brush_highlights.desc: Paint selections, focus and active pills as ink brush strokes.

prefs.ai.enter_to_send.desc: On: Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line. Off: Ctrl+Enter sends and Enter adds a line.

prefs.ai.show_avatars.desc: Show a small avatar next to your messages and the answers.
prefs.ai.show_timestamps.desc: Show the time under each message.
prefs.ai.side.desc: Edge of the screen the AI bar slides in from.
prefs.ai.strip_context.desc: How much of the model's context the conversation uses.
prefs.ai.strip_cost.desc: Tokens and approximate cost of the conversation.
prefs.ai.strip_engine.desc: Engine, model and reasoning effort; click it to switch.
prefs.ai.strip_limit.desc: How much of the current provider's subscription limit is used.
prefs.ai.suggestion_kinds.desc: What the suggestions may look at.
prefs.ai.suggestions.desc: Show suggestions based on what you are doing when a chat is empty.
prefs.ai.thinking_expanded.desc: Show the model's reasoning expanded instead of folded.

prefs.ai.context_warn.desc: The context meter turns amber and offers Compact from this fill level.

prefs.ai.keep_turns.desc: How many of your last messages (with their answers) stay verbatim when compacting.
prefs.ai.compact_model.desc: Model that writes the summary, e.g. a cheaper one; empty uses the chat's model.

prefs.ai.context_overrides.desc: Window size per model, for models the built-in table does not know or gets wrong.

prefs.ai.providers.visible.desc: A hidden provider is neither listed nor probed, and never shows as not connected.
prefs.ai.providers.timeout.desc: Longest time one chat request may take, streaming included.
prefs.ai.providers.retries.desc: Extra attempts after a network error, rate limit or overloaded server, only before any text arrived.
